strings.zh: 圓禿病人多為年輕成人、風險較低、但仍應於使用前個別評估上述風險、並與病人討論主要心血管事件、惡性腫瘤、嚴重感染、VTE 之風險訊號。Rudnicka 2024 EU 共識亦特別強調此 EMA 警示。
strings.en: Most alopecia areata patients are young adults at relatively low risk, but each should still be individually assessed and counseled about the warning signals for major cardiovascular events, malignancy, serious infection, and VTE. Rudnicka 2024 EU consensus reinforces this EMA warning.

strings.zh: 實務上，口服類固醇仍常作為「橋接治療」（快速壓制活動期），再轉為 JAK 抑制劑長期維持。Cyclosporine 與 MTX 在 JAK 不可使用、不可取得時為 off-label 替代方案。
strings.en: In practice, oral corticosteroids are commonly used as bridging therapy to rapidly suppress active disease before transitioning to a JAK inhibitor for long-term maintenance. Cyclosporine and methotrexate serve as off-label alternatives when JAK inhibitors are unavailable or contraindicated.

strings.zh: 對心理社交功能產生負面影響（壓力、焦慮、憂鬱、社交退縮）
strings.en: Negative impact on psychosocial function (stress, anxiety, depression, social withdrawal)

strings.zh: 眉毛或睫毛受影響而脫落
經至少 6 個月治療仍未達適當反應
strings.en: Inadequate response after at least 6 months of treatment

strings.zh: 進展快速且範圍廣泛，拉髮試驗陽性
strings.en: Rapidly progressive and extensive disease with a positive hair-pull test

strings.zh: 有心血管事件高風險(吸菸 / 高血壓 / 糖尿病 / 心衰 / 過去心肌梗塞或中風 / 家族史)
strings.en: High cardiovascular risk (smoking, hypertension, diabetes, heart failure, prior MI/stroke, family history)

strings.zh: 惡性腫瘤高風險(目前或過去吸菸者風險特別高)
strings.en: High malignancy risk (especially current or former smokers)

strings.zh: 主要靜脈血栓栓塞(VTE)高風險(肥胖 / 凝血疾病 / 口服避孕藥 / 重大手術 / 長時間制動)
strings.en: High VTE risk (obesity, thrombophilia, oral contraceptives, major surgery, prolonged immobility)

strings.zh: 85.5% 的病人在 40 歲前發病
strings.en: 85.5% of patients develop disease before age 40

strings.zh: 邊界清楚的圓形 / 橢圓形禿斑
strings.en: well-demarcated round or oval bald patches

strings.zh: 重大心理創傷與急性壓力
strings.en: Major psychological trauma and acute stress
